payload.text: 0084 (low, cc's): seven tests of a missing tool's refusal skip wherever the tool is installed. vc approved cc's design as written (19 Oct 09:39Z), after 0081: path_without <tool>, a farm of links to everything on PATH but the tool, one ln per PATH directory, last to first; only the verb runs under the farm, and bats keeps its own PATH. Proof by mutation, plus a control that the farm hides gpg while bash, env and cat resolve. Two points for the bytes: the farm is made once per test under BATS_TEST_TMPDIR, so nothing outlives the test; and the helper's header says the per-directory glob stays one argument list, well inside ARG_MAX. It lands after 0082, which also edits test_helper.bash, re-applied on its head.
